items.title: Structured outputs for the Realtime API
items.quote: Realtime sessions can now be constrained to a JSON schema, so partial audio responses are parsed as they arrive instead of after the turn ends.

items.title: Model spec update: clarifying refusal behavior
items.quote: The updated spec describes when the model declines a request and what it says instead.

items.title: Project-level usage limits in the API dashboard
items.quote: Admins can now set a monthly spending limit per project instead of only at the organization level.
